name: Folk Witch
description: A hedge wizard tradition of (mostly female) witches who brew potions, bind familiars, and organize into covens; both Gifted and unGifted members exist.

name: Folk Witch Magic Theory
description: The folk witch equivalent of Magic Theory, used to brew potions, investigate potions and open the Gift; familiars can also learn it.

name: Folk Witch Magic
description: The supernatural magic of folk witches, including potion brewing in the kitchen, familiars, Openings and initiations.

name: Potion Brewing
description: Folk witch laboratory activity of brewing doses of potions in the kitchen, costing vis per dose and effect; potions grant temporary Supernatural Abilities or effects.

name: Brew Potency
description: The strength of a folk witch potion, determining granted Ability scores, durations and its apparent magnitude to Hermetic detection.

name: Kitchen
description: The folk witch's equivalent of a laboratory, where she brews potions.

name: Concentrated Potions
description: Minor Supernatural Ability/Virtue allowing a folk witch to use more vis in brewing a season's potions.

name: Lab Text
description: A written record of a laboratory result; a literate folk witch can write one for a brew or longevity ritual, and gruagachan write theirs in Pictish Ogham.

name: Animal Ken
description: Supernatural Ability to communicate with animals; one of the folk witch favored powers, used for binding familiars and for potions.

name: Cursing
description: Supernatural Ability to inflict curses; a folk witch favored power that can be brewed into curse potions.

name: Dowsing
description: Supernatural Ability to find items or places; folk witch favored power used, for example, to find stolen property.

name: Flight
description: Supernatural Ability to fly; a folk witch favored power granted by potions and the Unbound by Land initiation.

name: Healing
description: Supernatural Ability to heal Wounds and Fatigue; a folk witch favored power, also used for the folk witch Longevity Ritual.

name: Second Sight
description: Supernatural Ability to see invisible things; a folk witch favored power, studied for the Sense of the Mystic breakthrough, and possessed by fetches.

name: Shapeshifter
description: Supernatural Ability to transform into an animal form; a folk witch favored power, and a Virtue sought in gruagach recruits.

name: Premonitions
description: Supernatural Ability to sense coming events; replaces Shapeshifter in the Orleans witches' variant tradition.

name: Animal Healing
description: Supernatural Ability suggested as an alternative folk witch power.

name: Entrancement
description: Supernatural Ability suggested as an alternative folk witch power.

name: Enchanting Music
description: Supernatural Ability suggested as an alternative folk witch power.

name: Nightwalking
description: Supernatural Ability suggested as an alternative folk witch power.

name: Wilderness Sense
description: Supernatural Ability suggested as an alternative folk witch power.

name: Supernatural Ability
description: Abilities with magical effects; folk witches' magic consists of these, and they lose them during the Witch Moon.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical substance used by folk witches to brew potions and by gruagachan to cast, study and enchant; traded at sabbats.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A magical link to a target; needed for emotion curse potions, and familiars serve as Arcane Connections to their witch.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Protection against magic that potions and spells must penetrate; Second Sight and Sense of the Mystic bypass it for sensing.

name: Things of Virtue
description: Natural items with magical properties which folk witches may enrich using Realms of Power: Magic rules.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: A ritual to slow aging; a folk witch can create one only for herself using her Healing Lab Total.

name: Organization Lore: Folk Witches
description: Lore Ability covering folk witch effects, where covens meet and the reputations of folk witches; its specialty must be a home coven.

name: Familiar
description: An animal bound to a folk witch in a season of lab work, gaining Intelligence, assisting in the kitchen and sharing a magical link with her.

name: True Friend
description: Minor Virtue gained by both folk witch and familiar through the familiar binding.

name: Warping
description: Accumulation of mystical change; for folk witches rising Warping Score triggers the Witch Moon, and for gruagachan it slowly turns them into trolls.

name: Witch Moon
description: The folk witch equivalent of Wizard's Twilight: a month-long fever during which she loses her Supernatural Abilities, afterward gaining a good or bad mark.

name: Wizard's Twilight
description: The Hermetic magus's reaction to Warping, to which the Witch Moon is the folk witch equivalent.

name: The Gift
description: The innate magical talent; Gifted folk witches and gruagachan have it Opened for favored Abilities or Arts.

name: Opening the Gift
description: Ritual opening a Gifted apprentice's magic; for folk witches it grants seven favored Supernatural Abilities, for gruagachan the six gruagach Arts.

name: Coven
description: A group of folk witches (usually three to a dozen) dispersed over a locale, the folk witch equivalent of a Hermetic covenant.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Hermetic ritual protecting a covenant, traditionally cast at the winter solstice; folk witches lack such shared rituals.

name: Wizard's Communion
description: Shared Hermetic ritual which folk witches cannot rely upon.

name: Initiation
description: Mystery process by which unGifted folk witches and gruagachan gain Supernatural Virtues via scripts with ordeals, quests and bonuses.

name: Mystagogue
description: The initiator who performs an initiation script on an initiate.

name: Initiation Script
description: A set of procedures (written or known) used to initiate a character; covens must purchase them with Build Points.

name: Sabbat
description: A meeting of a folk witch coven held on traditional festival dates, used to trade vis, brew potions cooperatively, Open the Gift and perform initiations.

name: Grand Sabbat
description: A gathering of many folk witch covens; one is held each All Hallow's Eve in Stonehenge and another on Walpurgis' Night at Brocken Mountain.

name: Precocious Girls
description: Gifted girls accidentally initiated as if unGifted by a coven.

name: Rhyme of the Beast
description: Folk witch initiation script requiring living as an animal for a season; grants Animal Ken and the Flaw Incomprehensible.

name: Venomous Darts
description: Winter folk witch initiation script granting the Major Virtue Cursing and the Flaw Magical Air.

name: Sense of Place
description: Folk witch initiation script requiring travel along a single path for a season; grants Dowsing and Motion Sickness.

name: Unbound by Land
description: Folk witch initiation script requiring a season above ground; grants Flight and Arthritis.

name: Hands of Life
description: Spring folk witch initiation script granting the Major Virtue Healing and the Flaw Enfeebled.

name: The Devil's Eye
description: Folk witch initiation script requiring an Arcane Connection to an invisible creature; grants Second Sight and Missing Eye.

name: Second Life
description: Folk witch initiation script requiring a cloak from a Beast of Virtue's hide; grants Shapeshifter and Age Quickly.

name: Sense of Time
description: Orleans witches' initiation script for Premonitions.

name: Incomprehensible
description: Minor General Flaw gained through Rhyme of the Beast.

name: Magical Air
description: Major General Flaw gained through Venomous Darts.

name: Motion Sickness
description: Minor General Flaw gained through Sense of Place.

name: Arthritis
description: Minor General Flaw gained through Unbound by Land.

name: Enfeebled
description: Major General Flaw gained through Hands of Life.

name: Missing Eye
description: Minor General Flaw gained through The Devil's Eye.

name: Age Quickly
description: Major Supernatural Flaw gained through Second Life.

name: Beast of Virtue
description: A magical beast whose hide is required for the Second Life initiation.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic protection that folk witches lack, leaving them exposed to the social effects of Gifted sisters.

name: Imbolg
description: Sabbat date on 1 February, also known as Brigid or Candlemas.

name: Eostre
description: Sabbat held at the Spring Equinox.

name: Beltane
description: Sabbat on 30 April/1 May, also May Day or Walpurgis' Night, when some local witches meet.

name: Lammas
description: Sabbat on 2 August, also Lugnasad.

name: Mabon
description: Sabbat held at the Autumn Equinox.

name: Samhain
description: Sabbat on 31 October/1 November, also All Hallow's Eve; the Stonehenge grand sabbat is held then.

name: Winter Solstice
description: Sabbat date and traditional time for casting the Aegis of the Hearth.

name: Summer Solstice
description: Sabbat date.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The game setting, where Christian festivals coincide with sabbat dates.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal where folk witch covens meet for a grand sabbat each All Hallow's Eve, and where gruagachan also exist.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal where covens hold a grand sabbat at Brocken Mountain, and scene of the Towers of War story seed.

name: Witches' Altar
description: Site on Brocken Mountain where Rhine covens hold a grand sabbat on Walpurgis' Night.

name: Brocken Mountain
description: Mountain in the Rhine region hosting the Witches' Altar grand sabbat.

name: Schism War
description: The war that destroyed House Diedne; its refugees are speculated to masquerade as folk witches, and afterward gruagach relations with the Order warmed.

name: Shadow Tribunals
description: Magi's term for organized grand sabbats of folk witches.

name: Customized Covenant Creation
description: Build Point rules for designing covenants, used to design covens.

name: Build Points
description: Points used to purchase coven resources, including initiation scripts; coven power level depends on them.

name: Hooks and Boons
description: Covenant creation features adapted for covens, such as aura, regio, urban and missing aura.

name: Witches of Reims
description: A folk witch coven in and around Reims, several of whose witches were burned by Archbishop William in the late 12th century.

name: Reims
description: French town where the Witches of Reims coven is based.

name: William
description: Archbishop of Reims who ordered witches burned as heretics in the late 12th century.

name: Mistress Greta
description: Elderly Gifted folk witch of Reims who escaped the stake by flying and now lives alone in a forest cave regio.

name: Forest Cave
description: Mistress Greta's remote cave with Magic aura 6, lying inside a regio.

name: Regio
description: A hidden magical realm-pocket; Greta's cave and Joseph's house lie in regiones.

name: Ars Grammatica
description: Book by Donatus (Artes Liberales Summa) held by the Reims coven.

name: Donatus
description: Author of Ars Grammatica.

name: Scent of Water
description: Anonymous Dowsing Summa in the Reims coven library.

name: The Piercing Tongue
description: Penetration Summa by Luzabel in the Reims coven library.

name: Luzabel
description: Author of The Piercing Tongue.

name: Townhouse (Reims)
description: Haunted ramshackle townhouse in Reims' poor quarter where Eliza lives, haunted by the burned witches' ghosts.

name: Eliza
description: Old unGifted folk witch living in the Reims townhouse, a healer of the poor whose rooster is her familiar.

name: Vineyard (Reims)
description: Vineyard near Reims on the Marne, owned by a small monastery, where Matilda lives.

name: Marne
description: River near Reims on whose banks lies Matilda's vineyard.

name: Matilda
description: Young Gifted folk witch of Reims living at a vineyard, trained by Mistress Greta; can turn into a dog.

name: Painless Witch Moon
description: Minor Virtue gained by Eliza from the Witch Moon.

name: Cyclic Magic
description: Virtue possessed by Matilda (positive, spring and summer).

name: Quiet Magic
description: Virtue possessed by Matilda; gruagachan may not have it, and if allowed it counts as Major.

name: Short-Ranged Curses
description: Flaw possessed by Matilda.

name: Life Linked Folk Witch Magic
description: Virtue possessed by Mistress Greta.

name: Expert Potion Brewer
description: Virtue possessed by Greta and Anne Kors.

name: Animal Healer
description: Minor Virtue gained by Greta from the Witch Moon.

name: Blatant Gift
description: Flaw possessed by Greta; also a Major Hermetic Flaw allowed for gruagachan.

name: Kilkenny Coven
description: A fractured folk witch coven in and near Kilkenny split between rival Gifted cousins Janine and Anne.

name: Kilkenny
description: Irish town home to the Kilkenny Coven.

name: Janine Kyteler
description: Older Gifted Kilkenny witch, merchant's wife who shapeshifts into a pig and seagull, rival of her cousin Anne.

name: Anne Kors
description: Gifted Kilkenny witch living in a manor outside town, rival of Janine, who can become a mare.

name: Agnes
description: Janine's sister, an unGifted folk witch on the family farm who stays neutral in the feud.

name: Janine's House
description: Kilkenny townhouse with a secret basement kitchen with Magic aura 4 and a vis spring.

name: Anne's House
description: Manor a few miles from Kilkenny with a lab outbuilding and a bog where a dying giant is pinned.

name: Dying Giant
description: A giant pinned to the earth by rocks near Anne's manor, whose blood yields Corpus vis.

name: Farmhouse (Kilkenny)
description: Farm in a Faerie-aura dell where Janine and Anne were taught; home of Agnes.

name: Venus' Blessing
description: Virtue possessed by Anne Kors.

name: Rigid Magic
description: Flaw possessed by Anne Kors.

name: Judged Unfairly
description: Flaw possessed by Anne Kors.

name: Feud
description: Flaw possessed by both Janine and Anne.

name: Unstable Magic
description: Flaw possessed by Janine Kyteler.

name: Reserves of Strength
description: Minor Virtue gained by Janine from the Witch Moon.

name: Temporal Influence
description: Virtue possessed by Janine and Jean the Wise.

name: Orleans Witches
description: A mostly male folk witch coven around Orleans practicing a variant tradition with Premonitions instead of Shapeshifter.

name: Orleans
description: French city around which the Orleans Witches operate.

name: Claude of Orleans
description: Only Gifted member of the Orleans Witches, rumored to have killed two rivals with curses; lives in a shack north of Orleans.

name: Claude's Shack
description: Shack by a stream north of Orleans near a ruined Roman villa with a magic apple tree.

name: Magistrate's Court
description: Orleans court where Jean the Wise uses Dowsing to find stolen property.

name: Jean the Wise
description: UnGifted Orleans witch and court clerk who uses Dowsing for the magistrate; his magic causes a ringing noise.

name: Joseph
description: UnGifted Orleans witch who became wealthy finding objects with Dowsing; lives in a regio house.

name: Reading the Perturbations of Place
description: Dowsing Summa by Goodwin in the Orleans library.

name: Goodwin
description: Author of Reading the Perturbations of Place.

name: Civitas Orleans
description: Civil and Canon Law tractatus by Magistrate Bayne.

name: Magistrate Bayne
description: Author of Civitas Orleans.

name: Warped Magic
description: Minor Flaw gained by Jean the Wise causing a ringing noise; also allowed to gruagachan.

name: Offensive to Animals
description: Flaw possessed by Jean the Wise; also a Minor Hermetic Flaw for gruagachan.

name: Meddler
description: Flaw possessed by Jean the Wise.

name: Hermetic Integration
description: Research projects to integrate folk witch practices into Hermetic magic via breakthroughs.

name: Subtle Opening
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue from a breakthrough integrating folk witch Opening; no Arts penalty when learning Supernatural Abilities.

name: Opening the Arts
description: Hermetic ritual opening an apprentice's Arts, varied by the Subtle Opening technique.

name: Breakthrough
description: Research advance measured in breakthrough points accumulated from Insights.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Hermetic order of magi, which integrates hedge magic and has a history with the gruagachan.

name: House Bonisagus
description: House whose magi research breakthroughs such as Subtle Opening.

name: Lineage of Pralix
description: Hermetic lineage that in a story seed makes the Subtle Opening breakthrough.

name: Order of Odin
description: Hedge wizards who might use Subtle Opening to learn Rune and Hermetic magic and infiltrate the Order.

name: Rune Magic
description: Magic of the Order of Odin.

name: House Tytalus
description: House whose magi appear in story seeds inventing Subtle Opening or Energy Magic.

name: Energy Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue from breaking the Limit of Energy, granting new Creo and Perdo Corpus Fatigue guidelines.

name: Limit of Energy
description: Hermetic limit that folk witches are not bound by.

name: Fatigue
description: Measure of tiredness; Energy Magic lets magi restore or drain Fatigue levels.

name: Pungent Potion of Ease
description: CrCo 20 charged potion restoring a Short-Term Fatigue level that becomes Long-Term on expiry.

name: Traveller's Respite
description: CrCo 30 ritual restoring one Long-Term Fatigue level to up to 10 individuals.

name: Energy Sense
description: InCo(Me) 20 spell sensing a target's Fatigue status.

name: Circle of Lethargy
description: PeCo 30 Ring spell preventing targets inside from recovering Fatigue by resting.

name: House Tremere
description: House whose low-ranking magi in a story seed use Energy Magic to overthrow superiors.

name: Certamen
description: Hermetic magical duel mentioned in the Balance of Power story seed.

name: Wizard's War
description: Sanctioned Hermetic conflict mentioned in the Balance of Power story seed.

name: House Diedne
description: House destroyed in the Schism War, masters of Spontaneous magic and bitter rivals of the gruagachan.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose Hoplites show surprising Spontaneous magic in a story seed.

name: Hoplites
description: Hermetic enforcers serving Quaesitors.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigators and judges.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Shapeshifting house whose sept wages war on towns in The Bjornaer Crusade story seed.

name: Divine
description: Realm of Power whose aura hinders magi.

name: Infernal
description: Realm of Power opposed by the Order.

name: Magic
description: Realm of Power to which folk witch abilities are aligned.

name: Faerie
description: Realm of Power; the Kilkenny farm lies in a Faerie aura.

name: Aura
description: Realm-aligned area power level affecting magic; covens purchase auras at each site and it caps sabbat assistants.

name: Sense of the Mystic
description: Major Hermetic Virtue from studying Second Sight; Intellego sense effects need not penetrate sensed creatures' Magic Resistance.

name: Lens of Glimpsing Spirits
description: InIm(Me) 34 constant-effect crystal lens in a brass ring that reveals invisible spirits.

name: Eyes for the Prince
description: InVi 15 spell detecting Faerie creatures of Might 40+ despite disguise or invisibility.

name: Ritual Items
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue allowing charged items with ritual effects, from integrating folk witch potion-brewing.

name: Stout Potion
description: CrCo 60 ritual charged potion increasing Stamina by 1.

name: Oil of Prometheus
description: CrIg 60 ritual charged oil that sets a Boundary aflame up to 60 miles in diameter.

name: Dram of the Lion
description: MuCo(An) 35 ritual charged potion turning the drinker into a lion for a year.

name: Dragon
description: A sleeping invisible dragon discovered within a covenant's Aegis in the Waking the Dragon story seed.

name: Redcap
description: Hermetic messenger who finds a devastated covenant in a story seed.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Tribunal bordering the Rhine whose archmagus's ritual wands are used to raise the Towers of War.

name: Curse of the Unportended Plague
description: PeCo 55 spell cited as an example ritual effect for a charged wand.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Art referenced in this text (e.g. vis type or spell arts).

name: Gruagachan
description: Hedge wizard tradition descended from Pictish priests of the god Gruagach, using tattoo magic, shapechange, curses and blessings; Warping turns them into trolls.

name: Gruagach (deity)
description: Pictish god of the sun, plants and animals, patron of the gruagachan who grants external souls and other favors.

name: Picti
description: Ancient people of Scotland, tattooed 'barbarians', whose priests founded the gruagach tradition.

name: Scotland
description: Land of the ancient Picti.

name: Troll
description: Warping slowly transforms every gruagach into a troll.

name: Loch Leglean Tribunal
description: Tribunal where gruagachan are primarily found.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Tribunal where some gruagachan exist.

name: Damhan-Allaidh
description: Wizard whom the gruagachan joined against the Order of Hermes.

name: Give
description: Gruagach Technique for granting blessings, curses, shapes and visions, and imposing geasa.

name: Take
description: Gruagach Technique for removing things from a target, covering nearly every Hermetic Technique.

name: Blessing
description: Gruagach Form conferring Virtues and bonuses balanced by a prohibition.

name: Curse
description: Gruagach Form inflicting Flaws and penalties with a removal condition.

name: Shape
description: Gruagach Form for changing the shape of self or others.

name: Vision
description: Gruagach Form of illusions, perception and glimpses of the future.

name: Gruagach
description: Free Social Status Virtue making the character a member of the gruagach tradition and a collective.

name: Gruagach Lore
description: Organization Lore of the gruagachan, covering their magic, members and initiation rites.

name: Pictish
description: Dead sacred language of the gruagachan serving as their magic theory and limiting their Art scores.

name: Ogham
description: Pictish script used by gruagachan to write Lab Texts and initiation scripts on stone or wood.

name: Giant Blood
description: Virtue regarded as a favor of Gruagach; unGifted recruits need it, Large or Shapeshifter.

name: Large
description: Virtue regarded as a favor of Gruagach, qualifying unGifted gruagach recruits.

name: Cailleach Magic
description: Major Supernatural Virtue from followers of Cailleach doubling the lowest Art in spontaneous casting.

name: Cailleach
description: Pictish earth goddess and companion to Gruagach.

name: External Soul
description: Major Supernatural Virtue placing the soul in an object, preventing death by injury and granting Unaging.

name: Gruagach Master
description: Minor Social Status Virtue: leader of a gruagach collective with unGifted students.

name: Fetch
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting an invisible magical animal companion with Second Sight that warns of danger.

name: Flexible Gruagach Magic
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a gruagach vary formulaic spells by 3 magnitudes.

name: Tattoo Mastery
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue reducing vis cost of gruagach tattoos by Pictish score.

name: Well-Trained Gruagach
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting extra experience in gruagach Arts and spells.

name: No Tattoo Magic
description: Major Supernatural Flaw preventing tattoo creation or investigation.

name: Transformation Prone
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: roll for transformation on a single botch; gained via Vision initiation.

name: Transformation
description: The gruagach equivalent of Twilight.

name: Incompatible Hedge Arts
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw preventing use of one Technique-Form combination.

name: Inflexible Magic
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw limiting spell variation to 1 magnitude.

name: Poorly Trained Gruagach
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw reducing experience in gruagach Arts and spells.

name: Weak Tattoo Magic
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw halving Lab Total for tattoos; gained via Shape initiation.

name: Dwarf
description: Flaw antithetical to Gruagach that unGifted gruagachan must never have.

name: Small Frame
description: Flaw antithetical to Gruagach that unGifted gruagachan must never have.

name: Gentle Gift
description: Major Hermetic Virtue allowed for gruagachan; lost via External Soul initiation.

name: Flexible Formulaic Magic
description: Hermetic Virtue analogous to gruagach spell flexibility.

name: Geas
description: A compulsion imposed by Give spells; Geas/Limit (Condition) Durations last until a condition is met.

name: Conversation
description: Gruagach Range equivalent to Touch/Eye, requiring conversation within three paces.

name: Bloodline
description: Gruagach Target affecting a bloodline.

name: Flexible Casting
description: Gruagach Mastery Ability increasing spell variation per 5 Mastery points.

name: Quiet Casting
description: Mastery Ability no gruagach may ever have.

name: Gruagach Tattoo
description: Enchanted tattoos, usually animal-shaped like Pictish carvings, imparting magical effects on their bearer.

name: Boar Tattoo
description: Example Give Blessing tattoo Dombnall creates for a Single Weapon bonus.

name: Dombnall
description: Example gruagach with an External Soul who creates a Boar Tattoo.

name: Gifted Gruagach Initiations
description: Scripts available only to Gifted gruagachan for Fetch and External Soul.

name: Ritual of Calling the Fetch
description: Gifted gruagach initiation fasting on a mountaintop to find the fetch; grants Fetch and Restriction.

name: Extractions of the Soul from its Husk
description: Gifted gruagach initiation placing the soul in a stone; grants External Soul and Blatant Magic.

name: Restriction
description: Flaw gained via Fetch and Give initiations (no magic on fetch's animal type, or while bald).

name: Blatant Magic
description: Flaw gained through Extraction of the Soul.

name: Ars Goetica
description: Infernal spirit magic rules referenced for gruagachan who command spirits.

name: Initiation into the Give Technique
description: UnGifted gruagach script requiring a quest for justice; grants Give and Restriction.

name: Initiation into the Take Technique
description: UnGifted gruagach script requiring oblations to Gruagach; grants Take and Dark Secret.

name: Initiation into the Blessing Form
description: UnGifted gruagach script requiring permanent aid to a hopeless person; grants Blessing and Weird Magic.

name: Initiation into the Curse Form
description: UnGifted gruagach script requiring poetic punishment of a wicked person; grants Curse and Vow.

name: Initiation into the Shape Form
description: UnGifted gruagach script requiring defeat of a shapechanger; grants Shape and Weak Tattoo Magic.

name: Initiation into the Vision Form
description: UnGifted gruagach script requiring fasting at a Pictish site; grants Vision and Transformation Prone.

name: Dark Secret
description: Flaw gained from the Take initiation's pagan ritual.

name: Pagan
description: Flaw substituted for Dark Secret if the character renounces Christianity.

name: Weird Magic
description: Flaw gained through the Blessing initiation; also allowed as Hermetic Flaw.

name: Vow
description: Flaw from the Curse initiation requiring fighting injustice.

name: Werewolf
description: Example shapechanger defeated for the Shape initiation.

name: Spontaneous Magic
description: Unprepared spellcasting; gruagachan always spend Fatigue, and House Diedne mastered it.

name: Formulaic Magic
description: Prepared spells at which gruagachan excel and can flexibly vary.

name: Ritual Magic
description: Ritual spells costing vis and Fatigue; gruagachan cannot perform Rituals.

name: Spell Mastery
description: Mastery of Formulaic spells available to gruagachan.

name: Magic Theory
description: Hermetic lab Ability for which Pictish substitutes among gruagachan.

name: Lesser Enchantment
description: Hermetic enchantment rules gruagachan use to create tattoos.

name: Penetration
description: Ability to overcome Magic Resistance.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Academic Ability; lets a character learn Ogham.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: Non-Hermetic magician, such as folk witches and gruagachan.

name: Infernalist
description: Diabolist; a bishop mistakes the Kilkenny coven for infernalists.

name: Laboratory
description: Workspace for lab activities; gruagach laboratories are writing materials and Lab Texts.
